text_block_list.text:
Carrying a large stack of documents, 
I make my way toward the trainers' offices.
choice_data_list: (Will I finally make my decision today?)

text_block_list.text:
Burdened by all the worries of a novice trainer, 
I ended up spending all my time just preparing…… 
I just couldn't bring myself to even speak to an Uma Musume.
——At that moment, I heard light-hearted voices.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
At lunch time, suddenly getting a cheer going!? But I guess 
that's just like Heart, and look at how many people showed up～!!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like it's to cheer on the girls participating 
in the next mock race! Heart's so passionate and kind～!

There was a group of flashy cheerleaders hyping up the crowd. 
And at the center of it all, the Uma Musume that drew my attention——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! Are you ready to get fired up? 
Looking down is such a waste! Raise your heads, look at me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Just let those bad vibes all get blown away! 
Everyone, all together, let our heart beats resonate♪

For those that walk this path, there were none that did not know…… 
From the prestigious "Hilleasta Academy", their ray of Hope.
——Now, many were eagerly awaiting her debut.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thanks for going along with my spur-of-the-moment idea. 
——……So, how was it? Are you all fired up now too?

text_block_list.name: Friend Entering the Race
text_block_list.text: Yeah……! I'm feeling so much better! Thank you, Heart!

With her exceptional talent, she must already have an 
exceptional trainer. There was no place for me here——As I 
readjusted the documents I was carrying and turned to leave——
(Byuuoooooo……!!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufuu…… I thought a passionate love 
letter had come flying my way. ——……Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……『The Correlation Between Relaxation and Explosive Top Speed』?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"While minimizing air resistance, reducing excess motion——and at the 
moment of impact, with an explosive burst of energy. By doing this——"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"This could help cover for any physical disadvantages." 
……Ohhhh, did you write this? There's quite the passion behind this.
choice_data_list: Just a bit of theorycrafting…… speculation……

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Not at all…… it's really interesting. It's basically a way to avoid 
getting overpowered and overcome a physical disadvantage, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Hey, can you let me borrow this?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It'll be fine. Don't worry, I'll properly return it! 
And I'll pay you back double…… on the double♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In exchange, the moment I make it a reality, you'll 
get to see that! You'll get to see that data come 
in live, it's the perfect chance, don't you think?

With just a look from her piercing blue eyes, my Heart skipped a beat. 
If…… she was serious, then, I can find out if my analysis is useful……——
choice_data_list: Yeah…… got it, you can borrow it!
Yeah…… got it, you can borrow it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Then, tomorrow morning, let's go for a run together♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See ya tomorrow, Mr. Audience!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: See ya tomorrow, Ms. Audience!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! I've memorized all the data. 
Alright, using your theory, I wonder what'll happen?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Can I leave timekeeping to you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Like parallel running? With that bike?
choice_data_list: I want to see your running from up close!
I want to see your running from up close!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Okay! Of course it's fine, make sure you get a good look♪

After she started running, she never looked back. 
As if tearing through the wind——sharp, powerful——she accelerated.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(——This theory, I'll turn it in to my wings. 
And then I…… I will overcome myself……!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(Fighting against my own limits, only looking 
forward——And just keep on pushing forward!)

No matter how fast I pedaled, she kept pulling further and 
further away. As if we resided in two different worlds……——

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nice work! Fufu, looks like you're really out of breath. 
I'm sorry, I couldn't help it…… and ran off without thinking.
choice_data_list: No…… it's fine. That's how it should be.
No…… it's fine. That's how it should be.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: But, you know…… you're quite amazing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Even just for a moment, I felt it. Just by relaxing 
for a moment, it felt like my entire body became 
a spring…… and with grace, surge forward.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I wasn't able to fully relax my 
shoulders, but it really was for an instant.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
This theory, with a bit more refinement, could be really 
useful. It certainly feels like there's something there.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if I notice anything else, can I ask you for advice? 
Seems like you have an interesting perspective…… how about it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: You're the best! Let's meet again at the academy♪

It was such a shock. I felt compelled to chase 
after that run——disregarding any logic from before.
